metadata.description: Community-maintained Claude Code plugins for SciX (NASA ADS) research workflows.

plugins.name: nasa-ads
plugins.description: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), read each paper in full once, and silently build a classified literature library of whole-article digests: one-line and paragraph summaries, a summary of every section, and citable findings with key values, locators, and verbatim anchors. Later work starts from the stored record, rereads only the exact paragraph behind a citation, browses with adslib, and exports citations.
